parameters.content:
WF2 - Send Campaign Email

Called by WF1 and WF5 with customer_id + email_sequence.

After import:
1. Every Google Sheets node: pick your service-account credential.
2. 'Get Settings' node: choose 'WF0 - Get Settings'.
3. 'OpenAI Generate Email': pick your OpenAI credential.
4. 'Send Email (Gmail SMTP)': pick your Gmail SMTP credential.
5. Do NOT activate; it only runs when called.
